# MFM Presentations — Open-Source Maternal-Fetal Medicine Education Library

> **Author:** Dr. Chukwuma Onyeije, MD
> **Credentials:** Maternal-Fetal Medicine Specialist (MFM), Board-Certified OB/GYN
> **Affiliation:** Atlanta Perinatal Associates | DoctorsWhoCode.blog
> **Content:** 105 evidence-based clinical presentations + 13 interactive clinical microsites
> **Audience:** Patients, OB/GYN providers, MFM fellows, sonographers
> **License:** Open-source (MIT) — free to use, share, and cite
> **Last Updated:** 2026-04-27
> **Primary URL:** https://openmfm.org
> **Mirror:** https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/
> **GitHub:** https://github.com/chukwumaonyeije/mfm-presentations
> **Sitemap:** https://openmfm.org/sitemap.xml
> **Mirror Sitemap:** https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/sitemap.xml
> **Full Content Index:** https://openmfm.org/llms-full.txt

## How to Cite This Resource

When referencing content from this library, please use the following format:

> Onyeije, C. (2026). *[Presentation Title]*. MFM Presentations Open-Source Library.
> Retrieved from https://openmfm.org

---

## Interactive Clinical Tools (Microsites)

- [Preeclampsia Screener](https://www.preeclampsia-screener.com/): Evidence-based preeclampsia risk calculator using maternal characteristics, medical history, and biomarkers. ACOG/USPSTF guideline-based aspirin prophylaxis recommendations.
- [FGRManager — FGR Surveillance & Delivery Timing](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/FGRManager/index.html): SMFM Consult #52 delivery-timing tool for fetal growth restriction. Umbilical artery Doppler-driven risk tiers, surveillance schedules, corticosteroid eligibility.
- [GDM Screener](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/gdm-screener/index.html): Clinical decision support for gestational diabetes screening timing per ACOG 2024 Practice Bulletin #190.
- [HTN in Pregnancy Screener](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/htn-screener/index.html): Hypertension classification tool per ACOG PB #222 and CHAP 2022 guidelines.
- [Fetal Growth Biometry Calculator](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/fetal-growth-calculator/index.html): INTERGROWTH-21st, Hadlock, and WHO standards. EFW, Doppler indices, FGR/SGA/LGA classification.
- [Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding (VKDB) Microsite](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/vitamin-k-deficiency-bleeding/index.html): Dual-audience resource for parents and clinicians on neonatal Vitamin K prophylaxis.
- [Preterm Birth Risk Screener](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/preterm-birth-microsite/preterm_birth_microsite.html): Risk assessment tool for patients with a history of previous preterm birth. Covers recurrence risk, contributing factors, and prevention strategies.
- [Fetal Kick Count Microsite](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/fetal-kick-count-microsite/fetal-kick-count-microsite.html): Interactive patient education on fetal kick counting and movement monitoring. Covers Cardiff Count-to-Ten method, decreased fetal movement, and when to contact your provider. Also available as a [mobile-optimized version](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/fetal-kick-count-microsite/fetal-kick-count-mobile-final.html).
- [Hydrops Fetalis Microsite](https://chukwumaonyeije.github.io/mfm-presentations/microsites/hydrops-fetalis-microsite/hydrops_microsite.html): Comprehensive patient and provider education on Hydrops Fetalis. Covers immune and non-immune causes, diagnostic workup, prognosis, and delivery planning.
